title: One Idea, Assembled Into a System

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: Show a single geometric idea splitting into nodes that rotate into place, connect and switch on as one system.
visuals: Static cool night field with seeded stars and stepped triangle ridges
Terracotta diamond idea with navy facet and a terracotta spark triangle
Six faceted hex nodes in sage, navy and terracotta
Light sage-cream connectors drawn outward from the idea
Warm terracotta glows and cream lamps as the event light

beats.development: The idea diamond rotates up around its pivot, the navy facet folds in, the spark drops into place and a warm glow rises; the headings slide in.
Six hex nodes split out of the idea's coordinates, each rotating one 120-degree step into its home position while connectors draw between arrived nodes.
The system switches on: node lamps light cream from the idea outward, the core and end glows rise, and the lower slate appears.
Settled hold on the completed, lit system with all copy legible.

findings: Assembly reads as three developments (idea, split/connect, switch-on) with overlapping cues so the eye follows left to right.
All motion completes by about 2.35 seconds, leaving a settled hold before 3 seconds.
justifiedHolds: 2.4-3.0s final hold lets the viewer read the headings and the completed system.

notes: Silent preview: no soundtrack or voice.
No preview recipe was supplied; the base style split/rotate/assemble implementation is demonstrated with a refreshed scene-dependent night palette.
